limitations: Single post-output AI review, not human adjudication.
Ordinary and purposive targeted cohorts must remain separate. No population accuracy claim.
Strict source-defined target granularity is unchanged after outputs: four targets are correctly ancestor-covered but not individually selected.
Type3 behavior remained enabled; three observed outputs retained separately.
No confirmed Type2 positives in this sample; the false Type2 result does not establish Type2 recall.
